ETH.note: No online identity check or e-signature service stated; returnees are said to access banking with the ID.
Nothing on a civil register to ID link.
No national enrolment count or share given.
Nothing on an ID number at birth.
Nothing on who operates or maintains the ID system.
No public register keyed on the ID number is stated.

facts.fact: IOM's Memory Mwale told ENA that all returnees passing through the IOM transit centre in Addis Ababa now receive an ID through the integrated Fayda national digital ID programme.
